issues.description: Mismatch in the requested output columns for Aufgabe 07: the problem statement (problem_statement.md line 48) asks for the textual names of the Gemeinden and the names of the respective Freibäder. The solution (solution_repository/aufgabe07.sql line 1) selects Gemeinde.schluessel and Schwimmbad.id (identifier columns) instead of Gemeinde.name and Schwimmbad.name. This mismatch will confuse students about which columns to return and will make automated checks that expect textual names fail or produce unclear feedback.
issues.suggestedFix:
Change the solution (and template/tests) to return the requested textual names. For example, update the query to:
SELECT Gemeinde.name AS gemeinde_name, Schwimmbad.name AS freibad_name
FROM Gemeinde, Schwimmbad
WHERE Gemeinde.schluessel = Schwimmbad.gemeindeschluessel
  AND Schwimmbad.art = 'Freibad';
Also update the template file to show the same expected columns and ensure any grading tests expect the textual name columns rather than identifier columns.
